cohort: 18 patients diagnosed with isthmocele and who underwent surgery between January 2012 and December 2017 at two tertiary referral centers in Rennes, France.
finding: Isthmocele surgery, regardless of surgical approach, was found to be effective for improving abnormal uterine bleeding, pelvic pain, and infertility.
mod_finding: Of the women who wished to conceive after surgery, 91.7% achieved pregnancy, and of the women who underwent surgery for infertility, 60% achieved pregnancy.
